author: Chris Schommer
title: Wyatt Langford collects three hits in loss to Red Sox
desc: Wyatt Langford went 3-for-5 in a loss to the Red Sox with one RBI.
impact: Langford continues a solid stretch at the plate since returning to the lineup, registering hits in five of his last eight contests. The 24-year-old remains one of many inconsistent options in the Rangers lineup, batting .241 with two home runs, seven RBI, 13 runs scored, and three stolen bases across 28 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jake Burger goes deep in loss to Red Sox
desc: Jake Burger went 1-for-3 in a loss to the Red Sox with a solo home run and one walk.
impact: Burger has heated back up at the plate, driving in runs in four of his last six contests. The first baseman remains one of many inconsistent options in the Rangers lineup, batting .248 with 12 homers, 42 RBI, 32 runs scored, and one stolen base across 68 games.

author: David Leisering
title: Pete Crow-Armstrong continues torrid stretch in Saturday win
desc: Pete Crow-Armstrong went 3-for-5 with a solo home run and two runs scored on Saturday as the Cubs defeated the Giants, 6-1.
impact: Crow-Armstrong hit the very first pitch of the game over the left-center field wall to jump-start the Cubs' offense. It was his 12th home run of the season and his fifth across 11 games in June. He also singled and doubled on Saturday, giving him at least three hits in a game for the third time in his last 13 contests. Crow-Armstrong has hit safely in 16 of his last 17 games and is hitting .370 (27-for-73) with 14 runs scored, six doubles, two triples, six home runs, 10 RBI, and three stolen bases over that span. He's up to .263 on the season with 12 homers, 33 RBI, and 15 stolen bases across 71 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Christian Walker goes deep as Astros edge Royals
desc: Christian Walker went 1-for-5 in Saturday's 8-7 win over the Royals with a home run, one run scored, and three RBI.
impact: Walker continues a productive stretch at the plate, collecting hits in nine of his last 11 contests. The first baseman remains one of the more explosive options as part of a streaky Astros lineup for manager Joe Espada, posting an .821 OPS with 18 homers, 52 RBI, and 41 runs scored across 71 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jose Altuve homers in win over Royals
desc: Jose Altuve went 2-for-4 in Saturday's win over the Royals with a two-run home run.
impact: Altuve has offered mixed results at the plate of late, recording hits in four of his last eight contests. The second baseman remains one of many streaky options in the Astros lineup to this point, batting .238 with six home runs, 31 runs scored, 15 RBI, and one stolen base across 50 games this season.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Brice Matthews goes yard in win over Royals
desc: Brice Matthews went 2-for-4 in a win over the Royals with a two-run home run.
impact: Matthews has provided mixed results at the plate, picking up hits in five of his last 10 contests. The outfielder remains one of the more inconsistent options when inserted in the Astros lineup for manager Joe Espada, batting .216 with six home runs, 18 RBI, 18 runs scored, and two stolen bases across 59 games.

author: David Leisering
title: Kyle Freeland roughed up in Saturday loss to Athletics
desc: Kyle Freeland allowed six runs on 10 hits in 5.2 innings on Saturday as the Rockies dropped a 7-5 decision to the Athletics.
impact: Freeland fell to 1-7 on the season with the loss and has now allowed five earned runs or more in six of his last eight starts. The veteran had a 2.30 ERA in his first three starts but, after a stint on the IL in late April, has gone 0-6 with an 11.13 ERA in his last eight outings. Freeland is scheduled to get the Pirates at home in his next start on Friday.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jake Meyers homers in tight win over Royals
desc: Jake Meyers went 2-for-4 in a win over the Royals with a solo home run and two runs scored.
impact: Meyers has fought consistency issues at the plate, picking up hits in five of his last 11 contests. The outfielder remains one of the more underperforming options in the Astros lineup, batting .221 with three homers, 10 RBI, and 12 runs scored across 35 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Yordan Alvarez racks up three hits in win over Royals
desc: Yordan Alvarez went 3-for-5 in Saturday's win over the Royals with one run scored.
impact: Alvarez has heated back up again, reaching base in each of his last 11 contests. The 28-year-old continues to reward manager Joe Espada with his explosive bat, carrying a 1.093 OPS with 24 home runs, 54 RBI, 49 runs scored, and one stolen base through 71 games.

author: David Leisering
title: Brett Sullivan goes deep in Saturday loss to Athletics
desc: Brett Sullivan went 1-for-3 with a solo home run and two runs batted in on Saturday during the Rockies' 7-5 loss to the Athletics.
impact: Sullivan hit his fourth home run of the season off of Joey Estes in the third inning to get the Rockies on the board. Over his last seven appearances, he is hitting .400 (6-for-15) with three home runs. The fourth-year catcher has already established career-highs in nearly every offensive category this season and is hitting .229 with four homers and 13 RBI in 36 games this season. Unfortunately for Sullivan, he just doesn't play often enough to be fantasy relevant.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Mike Burrows labors again in win over Royals
desc: Mike Burrows allowed four earned runs on seven hits and two walks while striking out five over five innings in Saturday's win over the Royals.
impact: Burrows has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing four earned runs or more in five of his last starts. The right-hander remains one of many underwhelming arms in the Astros rotation for manager Joe Espada, posting a 5.86 ERA and 1.58 WHIP with a 3-8 record and 7.5 K/9 ratio across 14 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jackson Chourio belts two homers in loss to Phillies
desc: Jackson Chourio went 4-for-5 in a loss to the Phillies with two home runs, two runs scored, and four RBI.
impact: Chourio continues a productive stretch at the plate, driving in runs in 10 of his last 14 contests. The outfielder continues to reward manager Pat Murphy with one of the more dynamic options in the Brewers lineup, carrying a .920 OPS with eight home runs, 25 RBI, 26 runs scored, and five stolen bases across 34 games.

author: David Leisering
title: Michael Soroka settles for no-decision Saturday
desc: Michael Soroka went seven strong innings in Cincinnati on Saturday, allowing just one run on two hits with no walks and seven strikeouts. However, the Reds went on to defeat the Diamondbacks, 2-1.
impact: Soroka's resurgence continued on Saturday as he allowed one run or fewer in a start for the eighth time in 14 outings this season. After struggling to a 5.71 ERA in April, Soroka has pitched to a 2.15 ERA in eight starts between May and June, while posting a 43:8 K:BB ratio during that stretch. Overall, the righthander is 8-3 with a 3.11 ERA and a 79:17 K:BB ratio in 81 innings this season and is certainly in the mix for his second career All-Star appearance next month.

author: Chris Schommer
title: William Contreras racks up three hits in tight loss
desc: William Contreras went 3-for-5 in a loss to the Phillies with one run scored.
impact: Contreras continues a steady stretch at the plate, collecting hits in seven of his last 12 contests. The 28-year-old continues to provide manager Pat Murphy with one of the more reliable options in the Brewers lineup, batting .291 with six home runs, 43 RBI, 39 runs scored, and one stolen base across 64 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Garrett Mitchell goes deep but Brewers come up short
desc: Garrett Mitchell went 2-for-5 in a loss to the Phillies with a two-run home run.
impact: Mitchell continues a productive stretch at the plate, picking up hits in six of his last nine contests. The outfielder remains one of the more inconsistent options in the Brewers lineup, batting .251 with four home runs, 33 RBI, 29 runs scored, and six stolen bases across 58 games.
